name: 14530 · Perry, NY
findings: ZIP 14530 (Perry) has 19 nonprofit organizations. 9 of them (47%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 6 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (43% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 14530 (Perry) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 14530 (Perry) list public events in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 59% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 7 organizations here; 21% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Does that match what people here experience? Where do people find public events now, including outside formal organizations?
